mapper.select: SELECT series_id FROM bike_pi WHERE id=#{piId}
mapper.sql: l.scope_type='SKU' AND l.customer_id=#{customerId} AND l.agent_id <=> #{agentId} AND l.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND l.expire_time>NOW(3) AND l.lock_qty>l.released_qty+l.converted_qty AND (l.lock_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT l.id,l.lock_no lockNo,l.sku_id skuId,s.sku_code skuCode,s.product_name productName,s.model_id modelId, l.lock_qty-l.released_qty-l.converted_qty remainingQty,l.expire_time expireTime FROM bike_inventory_lock l JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id WHERE ORDER BY l.id LIMIT #{offset},20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_inventory_lock l JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id WHERE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_pi_series(pi_no,current_pi_id,next_revision) SELECT pi_no,id,revision+1 FROM bike_pi WHERE id=#{piId} AND series_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi p JOIN bike_pi_series s ON s.current_pi_id=p.id SET p.series_id=s.id WHERE p.id=#{piId} AND p.series_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,current_pi_id currentPiId,next_revision nextRevision,version FROM bike_pi_series WHERE id=#{seriesId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi_series SET next_revision=#{revision}+1,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{seriesId} AND next_revision<=#{revision}
UPDATE bike_pi_series SET current_pi_id=#{piId},next_revision=GREATEST(next_revision,#{revision}+1),version=version+1 WHERE id=#{seriesId} AND current_pi_id=#{previousPiId}
mapper.select: SELECT pi_id,payload_hash payloadHash FROM bike_pi_revision_request WHERE operator_id=#{operatorId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_pi_order_link(order_id,series_id,created_pi_id,link_type) SELECT #{orderId},series_id,id,#{type} FROM bike_pi WHERE id=#{piId}
mapper.select: SELECT l.order_id FROM bike_pi_order_link l JOIN bike_pi p ON p.series_id=l.series_id WHERE p.id=#{piId} ORDER BY l.order_id
SELECT s.current_pi_id FROM bike_pi_order_link l JOIN bike_pi_series s ON s.id=l.series_id WHERE l.order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT o.id order_id,o.order_no,o.status,ri.sku_id,sku.sku_code, COALESCE(ri.ordered_qty,i.ordered_qty) ordered_qty,COALESCE(ri.shipped_qty,i.shipped_qty) shipped_qty, COALESCE(ri.closed_qty,CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED') THEN i.ordered_qty-i.shipped_qty ELSE 0 END) closed_qty, COALESCE(ri.ordered_qty-ri.shipped_qty-ri.closed_qty,CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED') THEN 0 ELSE i.ordered_qty-i.shipped_qty END) remaining_qty, reservation_status FROM bike_pi p JOIN bike_pi_order_link l ON l.series_id=p.series_id JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=l.order_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN bike_order_reservation_item ri ON ri.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN bike_production_sku sku ON sku.id=ri.sku_id WHERE p.id=#{piId} ORDER BY o.id,ri.sku_id

SELECT p.id,p.customer_id,p.status,p.release_status,p.shipment_required_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pay.amount) FROM bike_pi_payment pay JOIN bike_pi pp ON pp.id=pay.pi_id WHERE (pp.series_id=p.series_id OR (pp.series_id IS NULL AND p.series_id IS NULL AND pp.id=p.id)) AND pay.status='CONFIRMED' FOR UPDATE),0) paid_amount FROM bike_pi_order_link l JOIN bike_pi_series s ON s.id=l.series_id JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=s.current_pi_id WHERE l.order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.ordered_qty-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_pi_order_link l ON l.order_id=so.order_id AND l.series_id=p.series_id JOIN bike_production_vehicle shipped ON shipped.vehicle_id=so.vehicle_id WHERE so.status='COMPLETED' AND shipped.sku_id=i.sku_id FOR UPDATE) FROM bike_pi p JOIN bike_pi_item i ON i.pi_id=p.id JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.sku_id=i.sku_id WHERE p.id=#{piId} AND pv.vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_order_reservation r JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN bike_pi_order_link l ON l.order_id=o.id JOIN bike_pi_series s ON s.id=l.series_id JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=#{piId} AND p.id=s.current_pi_id SET r.hold_mode='PAID',r.payment_hold_pi_id=p.id,r.payment_held_at=NOW(3),r.payment_held_by=#{operatorId},r.payment_held_amount=#{paidAmount} WHERE r.order_id=#{orderId} AND r.hold_mode='TIMED' AND r.expires_at>NOW(3) AND o.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED') AND p.status IN ('CONFIRMED','RELEASED') AND #{paidAmount}>=p.deposit_required_amount
mapper.select: SELECT pi_id,payload_hash FROM bike_pi_conversion_request WHERE operator_id=#{operatorId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
